blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Atomistic machine learning can approximate expensive quantum mechanical calculations at a fraction of their computational cost, but accuracy depends strongly on how the three-dimensional atomic environments are represented. Invariant representations enable fast computation but can fail to distinguish geometrically distinct configurations, especially in highly symmetric environments. We introduce a lightweight benchmark to evaluate expressivity on $n$-fold symmetric configurations, and use it to expose degeneracies in both invariant and equivariant architectures. Guided by these results, we construct a new invariant basis for HIP-HOP which resolves most of the identified failures. On a methane simulation dataset, the extended basis achieves the lowest error among the HIP-HOP variants and has similar accuracy to EquiformerV3 while running $3.2\times$ faster at inference. These results show that carefully constructed invariant representations can mitigate key expressivity limitations while balancing accuracy and computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: 原子主义的机器学习可以以它们计算成本的一分之一来估计昂贵的量子机械计算,但准确性在很大程度上取决于三维原子环境是如何表现的. 变化无常的表示式可以使快速计算成为可能,但无法区分几何特征的配置,特别是在高度对称的环境中. 我们采用了一个轻量级基准来评价美元倍对称配置的表达性,并用它来揭露各种结构的变异性和等同性。 以这些结果为指导,我们为HIP-HOP构建了一个新的无变无常的基础,解决了大多数已查明的失败. 在甲烷模拟数据集上,扩展基础实现了HIP-HOP变体中最小的出错,并且与EquiformerV3具有相近的精度,同时在推论中运行了3.2\times$. 这些结果显示,精心构建的无差异表示可以减轻关键表达性限制,同时平衡准确性和计算效率.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Accurate atomistic simulation is central to understanding material properties, chemical reactions, and biological processes. While first principles quantum mechanical (QM) calculations ( Hohenberg and Kohn, 1964 ; Levy, 1979 ; Vignale and Rasolt, 1987 ) provide highly accurate results, their computational cost makes routine large-scale and long-timescale simulations challenging. Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have therefore emerged as efficient surrogates, reproducing QM-level accuracy at a fraction of the cost ( Behler and Parrinello, 2007 ; Smith et al., 2017 ) . Recent large-scale models such as UMA demonstrate how far this paradigm has advanced, scaling to hundreds of millions of training structures while enabling fast inference across diverse chemical systems ( Wood et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 精确的原子模拟对于理解材料性质,化学反应,以及生物过程至关重要. 第一原理是量子机械(QM)计算(Hohenberg和Kohn, 1964年; 列维, 1979; Vignale and Rasolt, 1987.))提供了高度准确的结果,他们的计算成本使得常规的大规模和长期规模模拟具有挑战性. 因此,机器学习的原子间潜力(MLIPs)已成为高效的代用物,以成本的一小部分复制出QM级的精度(Behler和Parrinello,2007;Smith等,2017.). 近期的大规模模型,如UMA,显示了这一范式的进步程度,其规模已扩大到数以亿计的训练结构,同时能够快速推导各种化学系统(Wood等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: A key factor behind the success of MLIPs is the incorporation of physical symmetries as inductive biases. For example, energy predictions are invariant to translations, rotations, and permutations of identical atoms, while forces transform along with the geometric transformations. Encoding these properties directly into neural architectures has become a cornerstone of geometric deep learning Bronstein et al. (2021) ; Cohen and Welling (2016) ; Weiler et al. (2023) , leading to substantial gains in accuracy and data efficiency.
blocks.zh: 多边投资协议取得成功的一个关键因素是将物理对称性作为诱导性偏见纳入其中。 例如,能量预测对同质原子的翻译,自转,和外观变化无常,而力则随几何变换而变化. 把这些属性直接编码为神经架构,成为了几何深层学习 Bronstein等(2021)的基石; Cohen and Welling (2016); Weiler等(2023),导致精度和数据效率大幅提高.

blocks.en: These approaches can be broadly divided into two strategies for incorporating symmetry, each with different tradeoffs. Invariant models ( Schütt et al., 2018 ; Gasteiger et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Allen et al., 2026 ) use scalar geometric quantities such as distances, angles, and inner products, enabling highly efficient computation in a reduced representation space, but potentially limiting expressivity if the invariants are not sufficiently rich to describe geometry. In contrast, equivariant models ( Liao et al., 2026 ; Kondor et al., 2018 ; Thomas et al., 2018 ; Weiler et al., 2018 ; Batatia et al., 2022b ; Batatia et al., 2022a ) retain vector and tensor-valued features that transform consistently under symmetry operations, preserving directional information and improving expressivity. This comes at increased computational cost due to operations on multi-component tensor representations.
blocks.zh: 这些方法可以大致分为两个纳入对称性的战略,每个战略都有不同的取舍. 变相模型(Schütt等,2018年;Gasteiger等,2020年;Wang等,2022年;Allen等,2026年)使用相距,相角等相位几何量和内出产等相位等相位几何量,使得在缩小的表示空间中能够高度高效地进行计算,但如果变相体不够丰富,可能限制表达力. 相形之下,等价模型(廖等等,2026;孔多尔等,2018;托马斯等,2018;魏勒等,2018;巴塔提亚等,2022b;巴塔提亚等,2022a等)保留了在对称操作下持续变换的矢量和高压特性,保存了方向信息并改进了表达性. 计算成本增加,原因是多元抗角表示法的运作。

blocks.en: This raises a central question: is explicit equivariant machinery strictly necessary for all tasks? Invariant representations are not inherently lossy; rather, their adequacy depends on whether they are complete, i.e., whether they distinguish all molecular configurations up to the prescribed symmetries. This suggests an alternative design point, namely constructing complete invariant representations that retain all symmetry-relevant geometric information while enabling fast computation.
blocks.zh: 这提出了一个中心问题:是否完全需要明确的等同机制来执行所有任务? 不定的表达方式并非固有地失去;相反,其充分性取决于其是否完整,即是否区分出所有分子构型到规定的对称. 这表明另一个设计点,即构建完整的不相干表示,保留所有对称相干几何信息,同时能够快速计算.

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce a new basis for HIP-HOP, an invariant architecture combining completeness with computational efficiency ( Allen et al., 2026 ) . Using an angular expansion up to ℓ max ​ = ​ 4 \ell_{\max}\mathord{=}4 , the representation captures finer angular structure while retaining invariance. The extended basis resolves the identified degeneracies and improves predictive accuracy.
This new model has similar accuracy to EquiformerV3 while offering higher inference throughput, though EquiformerV3 remains more accurate at larger model sizes.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们为HIP-HOP引入了一个新的基础,一种将完整性与计算效率相结合的无常结构(Allen等人,2026年)。 使用角放大到l 最大 = 4\ ell max = mathord = 4, 表示法在保留偏差的同时捕捉更细的角结构. 扩大的基础解决已查明的缺陷,并改进预测准确性。
这种新模型的精度与EquiformerV3相似,同时提供较高的推论吞吐量,尽管EquiformerV3在更大的模型尺寸上仍然更准确.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en:
We interpret the local atomistic configuration as a density on a
sphere and describe its shape by projecting it onto a polynomial basis truncated at a maximal angular order ℓ max \ell_{\max} , following the theory
of moment invariants ( Hu, 1962 ) in the flexible formulation of Bujack et al. (2025) . Intuitively, ℓ max \ell_{\max} plays the same role as the truncation order of a Fourier or Taylor series. Low orders capture only coarse angular features of the neighbor distribution, while higher orders resolve increasingly fine angular detail at increased computational cost. This mirrors the angular truncation used in atom-centered descriptors such as ACE ( Drautz, 2019 ) , and in equivariant networks built on spherical harmonics ( Thomas et al., 2018 ) . The resulting projections, called geometric moments, form Cartesian tensors. Because products and contractions of tensors are again tensors, every rank-zero contraction of a product of moment tensors is a scalar and therefore a rotation invariant. Infinitely many such contractions exist and most are redundant, so we identify an independent subset using Langbein’s algorithm ( Langbein, 2014 ; Bujack et al., 2025 ) to obtain a compact basis.

We first evaluate HIP-HOP on the N-body benchmark ( Pozdnyakov et al., 2020a ; Joshi et al., 2023 ) to compare the ability of invariant and equivariant models to resolve geometric interactions. To complement the N-body benchmark, we introduce a lightweight synthetic dataset designed to evaluate highly symmetric local environments, including configurations with n n -fold symmetry. This benchmark provides a controlled setting that is less contrived than the N-body benchmark while remaining simple enough to isolate differences in model expressivity, and is motivated by known degeneracies of finite-order atom-centered invariant representations ( Bujack et al., 2025 ) .
We construct graphs with a central node surrounded by two rings and vary their populations and relative rotation to generate configurations with different n n -fold symmetries. For each configuration, we consider orientations that minimize or maximize the distance between nodes on different rings, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . Additional details can be found in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
我们首先根据N-body基准(Pozdnyakov等,2020年a;Joshi等,2023年)评估HIP-HOP,以比较非变量和等位模型解决几何相互作用的能力。 为了补充N-body基准,我们引入了轻量级合成数据集,旨在评价高度对称的局部环境,包括n-倍对称的配置. 这一基准提供的控制设置比N-体基准的构思要少,同时保持足够简单,以隔离模型表达性的差异,其动机是已知的以有限序列原子为核心的不变量表示的变性(Bujack等,2025年)。
我们用两个环环相绕的中心节点构造出图表,并改变其数量和相对自转,以生成不同n-倍对称的配置. 对于每个配置,我们考虑将不同环上节点之间的距离最小化或最大化的取向,如图所示. 1 其他详情见附录C。

blocks.en: Figure 1: For the rings benchmark, the model is given two rotated versions of the same graph, and must determine which orientation has the nodes closer together.
blocks.zh: 图1: 对于环比基准,模型被赋予了同个图的两个旋转版本,必须确定哪一个取向有更相近的取向.

blocks.en: To test how basis expressivity affects real-world performance, we evaluate our model on the randomly displaced methane dataset of Pozdnyakov et al. (2020b) , containing over seven million configurations with DFT energies and forces. Methane provides a challenging four-neighbor environment, making it a natural test of the additional geometric resolution introduced by extending the basis to ℓ max ​ = ​ 4 \ell_{\max}\mathord{=}4 .
blocks.zh: 为了测试基础表达性如何影响现实世界的表现,我们评价了波兹德尼亚科夫等人(2020年b)随机移动的甲烷数据集的模型,其中包含有超过700万个具有DFT能量和力量的配置. 甲烷提供了具有挑战性的四邻环境,通过将基数扩展为l max = 4\ ellmax = mathord = 4,使其成为对所引入的额外几何分辨率的自然测试.

blocks.en: We extend the original construction of HIP-HOP using the flexible moment-invariant framework of Bujack et al. (2025) to obtain a new basis through ℓ max ​ = ​ 4 \ell_{\max}\mathord{=}4 . The resulting basis and its tensor-contraction structure are shown in Appendix E . Increasing the basis size improves model expressivity but also introduces higher-order polynomial terms and increased computational cost. To mitigate this overhead, we parallelize both the construction and evaluation of the invariant polynomials.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Bujack等人(2025年)的灵活瞬间变量框架,延长了HIP-HOP的最初构建,以便通过l max = 4\ ell-max- mathord-4获得新的基础。 由此产生的依据及其热-收缩结构见附录E。 扩大基数规模可改善模型的表达性,但也引入了更高级的多名词和更高的计算成本. 为了减轻这种间接费用,我们同时建造和评价变化无常的多元体。

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: Figure 2: The n n -body benchmark (A) accuracy is saturated for all bases, but the rings benchmark (B) shows the difference in expressivity between bases.
blocks.zh: 图 2:n-body基准(A)精度对所有碱基是饱和的,但环基准(B)显示碱基之间表达性的差异.

blocks.en: Consistent with the theoretical predictions of Allen et al. (2026) , HIP-HOP with basis functions up to ℓ max ​ = ​ 3 \ell_{\max}\mathord{=}3 successfully resolves interactions up to three-body and the expanded ℓ max ​ = ​ 4 \ell_{\max}\mathord{=}4 basis does not improve the expressiveness ( Fig. 2 ). The static performance across all models and invariant bases motivates us to additionally evaluate with the rings benchmark to test changes in expressiveness.
blocks.zh: 与Allen等人(2026年)的理论预测一致,HIP-HOP的基础函数最多为l max = 3\ell max = mathord = 3 成功解决了最多为三体的相互作用,而扩展为l max = 4\ellmax = mathord = 4的基础并不能改善表达性(图2 ). 所有模型的静态性能和变化无常的基础促使我们用环基准进行额外评价,以测试表达性的变化.

blocks.en: On the rings benchmark, the original HIP-HOP basis fails, as expected, to distinguish patterns involving four-fold symmetric configurations. Extending to ℓ max ​ = ​ 4 \ell_{\max}\mathord{=}4 resolves most cases; however, both HIP-HOP and EquiformerV3 fail on the (3/4) configuration ( Fig. 2 ). This behavior appears consistent with the singular degeneracy recently described in Domina and Ceriotti (2026) , which we discuss further in Appendix F . Adding an additional contraction to the basis resolves these special configurations, though it did not provide measurable benefits in subsequent experiments (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 在环比基准上,原HIP-HOP基础未能如预期那样区分出涉及四倍对称配置的图案. 扩展至l max = 4\ ell max = mathord = 4 解决了大多数情况;然而,HIP-HOP和EquiformerV3在3/4配置(图2)上都失败了. 这一行为似乎与最近Domina和Ceriotti(2026年)描述的单一变性相一致, 将额外的收缩加入基础可以解决这些特殊配置,尽管在之后的实验中并没有提供可衡量的效益(附录A.

blocks.en: The new ℓ max ​ = ​ 4 \ell_{\max}\mathord{=}4 basis consistently achieves the lowest errors among the small HIP-HOP configurations across all four metrics ( Sec. 3 and Appendix A ). At roughly 36K parameters, it nearly matches EquiformerV3 in accuracy while running 3.2 × 3.2\times faster at inference. At 1.1M parameters, EquiformerV3 achieves lower error, but HIP-HOP remains 2.4 × 2.4\times faster at inference. Parallelization further improves both the one-time basis construction and inference speed, making the new basis 1.57 × 1.57\times faster (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 新的l max = 4\ ell max = mathord = 4 基数一致地实现了所有四个度量标准(第3项和附录A)中HIP-HOP小配置中的最低出错。 在大约36K参数下,它几乎与精度相匹配EquiformerV3,同时在推论中运行3.2×3.2\时速更快. 在1.1M参数下,EquiformerV3实现了更低的误差,但HIP-HOP在推论上仍然保持2.4×2.4\时速快. 平行化进一步提高了一次性基础建设和推论速度,使新的基础1.57×1.57\时间更快(附录D.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 讨论和结论

blocks.en: We introduced a benchmark for systematically identifying failures of invariant and equivariant representations in highly symmetric atomic environments. Using this benchmark, we showed that low-order representations fail to distinguish several geometrically distinct configurations, whereas increasing ℓ max \ell_{\max} and introducing targeted higher-order contractions can recover much of the missing geometric information.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了一个基准,以系统地确定在高度对称的原子环境中的不一致和等同表述的失败。 使用这个基准,我们显示,低序表示法无法区分几种几何特征,而增加l max 最大\ ell max 和引入定向高序收缩可以恢复所缺少的许多几何信息。

blocks.en: The rings benchmark suggests that increasing angular resolution can recover geometric distinctions inaccessible to lower-order invariant bases. The failure on the (3/4)-rings configuration shows that finite invariant representations can retain isolated degeneracies even at higher ℓ max \ell_{\max} . Interestingly, the additional contractions designed to resolve these special cases did not improve performance on the methane dataset, indicating that formal expressivity and practical predictive accuracy are not always directly aligned.
blocks.zh: 环比基准表明,增加角分辨度可以恢复低等不相干基所无法进入的几何分辨. 3/4-环配置的失败表明,有限的无变异表示即使在高l 最大\ ell\ max 上也能保留孤立的畸变 。 有趣的是,为解决这些特例而设计的额外收缩并没有改善甲烷数据集的性能,表明形式表达性和实际预测准确性并不总是直接对齐.

blocks.en:
We then investigated whether the additional expressivity translates to improved molecular modeling on the methane dataset. The larger basis consistently achieved the lowest energy and force errors among the evaluated HIP-HOP configurations.
At 36K parameters, HIP-HOP nearly matched the accuracy of EquiformerV3 while running 3.2 × 3.2\times faster at inference. At 1.1M parameters, EquiformerV3 was more accurate, though HIP-HOP remained more than twice as fast.
Together with the reduced basis-construction runtimes provided by our parallel implementation, these results demonstrate a favorable trade-off between predictive accuracy and computational efficiency.
blocks.zh:
然后,我们调查了额外的表达性是否 转化为改进的分子模型 在甲烷数据集。 更大的基础始终实现了受评价的HIP-HOP配置中能量和力差最低的目标。
在36K参数上,HIP-HOP几乎与EquiformerV3的精度相匹配,同时在推论中运行3.2×3.2\时速更快. 在1.1M参数中,EquiformerV3更准确,尽管HIP-HOP仍然保持了两倍多的速度.
这些结果,加上我们平行执行所提供的建设基础的运行时间缩短,显示出预测准确性和计算效率之间的有利取舍。

blocks.en: Overall, our results provide a practical framework for diagnosing representation failures, constructing more expressive invariant bases, and evaluating the relationships among formal expressivity, predictive accuracy, and computational efficiency in machine-learned interatomic potentials.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的成果为诊断表达失败、构建更能表达的不变量基础以及评估形式表达性、预测准确性以及机器-原子间潜力的计算效率之间的关系提供了一个实用的框架。

blocks.en: Appendix A Methane Training Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 甲烷培训详情

blocks.en: We train each model using a fixed pool of 10 6 10^{6} methane configurations and evaluate performance on a separate held-out test set of 80,000 configurations. Energies and forces are converted to kcal/mol and kcal/mol/Å, respectively, and models are optimized using the sum of energy and force MAE and RMSE with L2 regularization. Training uses early stopping based on validation energy MAE with a patience of 300 epochs, while the batch size is increased after 150 epochs without improvement.

blocks.en: Appendix C Ring Dataset Details
blocks.zh: 附录 C 环形数据集细节

blocks.en: For each ring configuration ( n inner , n outer ) (n_{\mathrm{inner}},n_{\mathrm{outer}}) , we construct a local environment consisting of a central node and two rings containing n inner n_{\mathrm{inner}} and n outer n_{\mathrm{outer}} nodes. All nodes have the same species. Edges connect the central node to every ring node, with no edges between nodes on either ring. For each configuration, we generate two graphs that differ only in the distance between the rings. The graphs are assigned binary labels according to the minimum Euclidean distance between an inner-ring and outer-ring node, with the smaller-distance configuration labeled “close” and the larger-distance configuration labeled “far.” Because each task contains one graph from each class, random accuracy is 0.5. We experimented with assigning the same radius for the inner and outer rings, but found that the accuracy of the models was identical to when the radii of the rings was different ( Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 对于每个环的配置(n内,n外) (n_{\mathrm{inner}},n_{\mathrm{outer}}),我们构建一个由中央节点和两个包含n内n_{\mathrm{inner}}和n外n_{\mathrm{outer}}]节点组成的局部环境. 所有节点都有同种. 边缘将中心节点与每个环形节点相接,两个环上节点之间没有边缘. 对于每个配置,我们生成两个仅以相环相距相差的图. 图表根据内环和外环节点之间的最小欧几里得分被指定二进制标签,较小的相距配置被标记为"相近",较大相距配置被标记为"相距". 因为每个任务都包含每个类中一个图,所以随机精确度为0.5. 我们曾尝试为内环和外环指定相同的半径,但发现模型的精度与环的光度不同时完全相同(图3.

blocks.en: Appendix E New basis for ℓ max ​ = ​ 4 \ell_{\max}\mathord{=}4

blocks.en: To extend HIP-HOP to higher angular resolution, we construct an invariant basis including channels up to ℓ max ​ = ​ 4 \ell_{\max}\mathord{=}4 , following the flexible moment-invariant framework of Bujack et al. (2025) .

blocks.en: The resulting tensor-contraction basis used in our model is summarized in Fig. 5 . This figure provides a visual representation of how the different invariant scalars are calculated. Each individual graph specifies a particular tensor contraction that evaluates to a scalar. Each node labeled ℓ \ell represents a rank- ℓ \ell tensor T ( ℓ ) T^{(\ell)} , while each edge represents a pair of tensor indices that are contracted with one another. Multiple edges between two nodes indicate that several indices are contracted between the same pair of tensors. The degree of each node therefore equals the rank of its corresponding tensor.

blocks.zh: 附录F 单平面上的星相

blocks.en: Representing a spatial structure in a reduced or truncated basis can result in a loss of geometric information, such that distinct configurations become indistinguishable at finite ℓ max \ell_{\max} , as recently discussed in Domina and Ceriotti (2026) . Motivated by this behavior, we arrived at a related observation independently, without the use of AI, by studying how ( n ) (n) -fold symmetric structures behave under projection to the invariant basis. In the following, we examine this effect in the simpler setting of a single plane and characterize the problematic configurations. For simplicity, we describe the problem in the original HIP-HOP ℓ max ​ = ​ 3 \ell_{\max}\mathord{=}3 basis. As shown in Fig. 4 , the original HIP-HOP basis unexpectedly fails for the ( 2 / 3 ) (2/3) -ring case (described in Fig. 3 ). We therefore analyze this case in more detail to understand the origin of the failure. An analogous behavior is observed for the ( 3 / 4 ) (3/4) -ring configuration in the HIP-HOP ℓ max ​ = ​ 4 \ell_{\max}\mathord{=}4 basis.
blocks.zh: 如最近Domina和Ceriotti(2026年)所讨论,在缩小或缩短的基础上代表空间结构可能导致几何信息的损失,以致不同的配置在有限l max ( max) 时无法区分。 在这种行为的推动下,我们独立地得出了相关的观察结果,没有AI的使用,研究了(n)-(n)-倍对称结构如何在投影到不常态的基础上表现. 在下文中,我们用一个单平面的更简单的设置来检查这种效果,并描述出有问题的配置. 简而言之,我们在最初的HIP-HOP l max = 3\ell max = mathord 3 基数中描述了这个问题. 如图4所显示,最初的HIP-HOP基数在(2 / 3) (2/3)-环(在图3中描述)的情况下出乎意料地失败了. 因此,我们更详细地分析此案,以了解失败的根源。 HIP-HOP l max = 4\ ell max- mathord * 4 基础中的 (3/ 4)(3/4) - 环配置被观察到类似的行为.

blocks.en: To analyze the ( 2 / 3 ) (2/3) -ring configuration, we continuously rotate the two-fold symmetric component relative to the three-fold symmetric component and evaluate the corresponding basis functions, plotting only the nonzero responses shown in Fig. 6 . The original HIP-HOP basis is shown on the left, while the improved basis is shown on the right, with the two separated by a dashed line. As seen, all contractions in the original basis remain constant under the rotation, even though the configurations are distinct. Thus, the original invariants fail to distinguish the relative orientation of the two rings. The additional contraction is functionally independent of the original contractions on this specific manifold and therefore varies with the relative rotation between the two rings. We constructed this contraction using an algorithm similar to that described in ( Bujack et al., 2025 ) .

On this symmetry-constrained manifold, the tensor components depend only on a a , b b , c c and relative rotation angle θ \theta . Substituting these expressions into the contractions and simplifying them allows us to determine directly which invariants retain information about the relative orientation of the two symmetric components.

(9) Although these additional contractions are important from a theoretical perspective, they are computationally expensive and provide only limited practical improvement in the experiments, as shown in Table . We interpret this as being consistent with the expectation that exactly planar atomic configurations associated with these singularities are very rare in realistic datasets.
